title: Public blasts Auburn wind turbine project at the first public forum - NewsBreak
text: AUBURN, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) — People didn’t hold back at the podium during Wednesday night’s public forum about Auburn’s wind turbine project. The Agricola Wind project aims to build turbines on a large plot of land between the Town of Venice and Scipio. The public showed up outside the hotel hosting the forum, hours before the 6 p.m. start time on Wednesday, August 6. They held signs in protest of the project, mostly focusing on the environmental impacts. During the forum, people brought up issues of environmental damage, the cost of the project and noise pollution. “People are gonna come up here, pour their hearts out, and we’re gonna give them proof,” said Dennis Rossbach, an opponent of the project. “I don’t think anyone here thinks it’s gonna change a damn thing.” The forum recorded all comments from the public about the project, both in person and those sent in online. “That’s really what tonight’s event is for, it’s for everyone who has comments,” said Director of Development for Liberty Renewables Scott Biggar. “It’s going on record for the state.” Comments can be emailed in by 5 p.m. Friday, August 8 at ores.comments@dps.ny.gov . For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WSYR.
